name: Cottage pizza mini-muffins (מיני מאפינס פיצה מקוטג')

source.author: Recipe-app screenshot (Hebrew)
source.notes: Mini 'pizza' muffins: cottage cheese + 9% yellow cheese + egg + a little flour/baking powder, with tomato sauce and fresh basil, baked in a muffin tin ~20–25 min at 220°C until golden. Makes 6. MACROS ARE THE CARD'S OWN per-muffin values (80 kcal / 7.5 g protein / 8 g carb / 2.5 g fat). The screenshot is low-resolution, so the ingredient quantities below are a best reading (≈60 g grated 9% yellow cheese, ≈100 g cottage 3%, small amounts of flour and white cheese, 1 egg, baking powder, ≈50 g tomato sauce, fresh basil; salt / parmesan / oregano to top) — send a clearer shot to confirm. Manual intake — reference only, not adopted.

steps: Preheat the oven to 220°C and grease a muffin tin.
Mix the cottage, egg, flour/white cheese and baking powder into a batter.
Fold in the grated yellow cheese, tomato sauce and basil.
Divide into 6 muffin cups and top with a little parmesan and oregano.
Bake ~20–25 min until golden and set; cool a few minutes before unmoulding.

batch_totals.note: All 6 muffins, from the card's per-muffin values. ~9.4 g protein per 100 kcal — very lean for a 'pizza' snack.

him.verdict: A very lean savoury snack: 80 kcal and 7.5 g protein per muffin (~9.4 g protein per 100 kcal), so 3 muffins is a ~240 kcal / ~22 g protein snack or light meal that scratches a pizza craving. Low fat thanks to cottage 3% and 9% yellow cheese. Low in fibre; tomato sauce adds a bit of lycopene.
flags: 80 kcal / 7.5 g protein per muffin (~9.4 g/100 kcal)
suggested_mods: Use whole-spelt flour for a little fibre
Fold in chopped spinach or roasted peppers/mushrooms for volume and micros
Pair with a salad to make it a light meal

her_preconception.verdict: Good for her: pasteurized cheeses, fully baked egg, protein + calcium in a portable snack. Not a folate or iron source on its own — adding spinach would help.
suggested_mods: Fold in spinach for folate + iron

cooking_guide: Grease the muffin tin well (or use silicone) — cheesy batters stick.
Mix the batter just until combined; overmixing makes egg-and-cheese bakes rubbery.
If using fresh vegetables, chop them small and pat dry so the muffins don't go soggy.
Bake on the middle rack at the high 220°C until golden on top; check from ~18 min.
Let them rest 5 minutes in the tin — they firm up and release cleanly.
